model_or_product: Fuzz Tone Generator; Bass-Treble Expander; Signal Booster; Sound-Go-Round; Chord & Note Sustainer; Acoustic Feedback Eliminator; Automatic Level Control
evidence_summary: Period trade material identifies Walco Electronics as a division of Walco-Linck Corporation in Clifton, New Jersey, while surviving Walco effects are documented as Japanese-made and the Effects Database lists a seven-product effects catalog. The evidence supports a real Walco-Linck marketed electronics lineage, but does not yet identify the Japanese contract factory for the effects. Preserve Walco-Linck as the U.S. brand/company node and keep the physical Japanese manufacturer unresolved.
